falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 81% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottoming pattern required lower lows and consolidation; a breakout to new highs demonstrates the structure was not a bottom but a failed breakdown, making the current signal wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency and risk-on positioning inconsistent with a bottoming regime; the August 2024 bottom featured VIX spikes above 20, so this would prove the market is not repricing risk as the pattern suggests

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield rises above 4.50% and holds there for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp rates breakout would signal inflation/reacceleration fears rather than the growth-scare bottoming environment of August 2024 (when yields fell toward 3.7%); this would break the macro analog and show the current 'bottom' call missed a regime shift to bond-driven risk-off

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
